did_you_know.fact: On March 13, 2020: Katerina Sakellaropoulou is sworn in as the first female President of Greece amid strict COVID-19 measures.

did_you_know.fact: On March 13, 1988: The Seikan Tunnel, the longest tunnel in the world with an undersea segment, opens between Aomori and Hakodate, Japan.
On March 13, 1781: William Herschel discovered the planet Uranus from the garden of his house in Bath, England, initially considering it to be a comet.
On March 13, 624: The Battle of Badr, the first major battle between the Muslims and Quraysh.
March 13 is observed as National Elephant Day (Thailand).
